a: CONTRIBUTING.md explains how to set up, code style, and PR process.
A CoC sets community behavior expectations.
Templates gather repro steps and environment details.
Labels (bug, enhancement, good first issue) organize work.
Call out breaking changes loudly in release notes.
Good first issues with mentorship grow contributors.
Set boundaries; share ownership; it is okay to archive.
Some projects require CLA or Developer Certificate of Origin.
